generate_html_tree_visualization: generate an HTML visualization of a journal tree graph from a JSON string using template files
export_journal_to_html: export a Journal object to an HTML file with tree visualization, code, and metrics
extract_tree_edges: extract parent-child edge pairs from a Journal object for graph layout purposes
generate_tree_layout: generate a Reingold-Tilford tree layout for a given number of nodes and edges using igraph
format_prompt_messages: format a list of role-based message dictionaries into human-readable prompt text with headers
